summary: Verified the agent-server bound to port 8787 with active connections after restart, then ran prettier, tsc, svelte-check, git diff, and git status. Staged and committed all modified files plus .pi artifacts (later removed) as 'b753f45 feat: bind and reload Pi extension runtimes', producing the third in a series of three commits on pi-web (ahead 3 of origin).

Created a single commit ('b753f45 feat: bind and reload Pi extension runtimes') covering Pi extension binding, runtime reload, Windows pi-web:dev fix, and README/docs updates
Removed the .pi/ directory (containing agent-server logs and pid file) that had been tracked in the commit, leaving a clean working tree
